item.title: Gene therapies for hearing loss show promise despite recent setbacks in the field
item.description: Gene therapies aimed at treating hereditary deafness have shown promising early results amid wider safety concerns facing genetic medicines. Experts say localized delivery may help reduce risks while expanding future treatment options.

item.title: Kevin Tang appointed CEO as Aurinia Pharmaceuticals restructures leadership team
item.description: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals has appointed Kevin Tang as CEO while overhauling its executive team with several new leaders from Tang Capital Management. The move comes amid efforts to expand Lupkynis sales and advance a competitive drug pipeline.

item.title: Pfizer expresses confidence in Lyme vaccine after mixed Phase 3 trial results
item.description: Pfizer announced it remains confident about its experimental Lyme disease vaccine despite mixed results from a large clinical trial with partner Valneva. The company plans regulatory submissions as analysts weigh historical challenges faced by similar vaccines.

item.title: Validated mechanisms and strong data emphasized in longevity investing, experts say
item.description: LongeVC leaders say validated scientific approaches are key for progress in longevity investing. Start-ups are urged to target specific diseases with strong data rather than chasing broad anti-aging claims.

item.title: Lung cancer survivors and advocates to meet Congress for research and care funding
item.description: More than 50 advocates affected by lung cancer will visit Capitol Hill during LUNG FORCE Advocacy Day on March 25. They aim to secure increased federal funding for research at NIH and public health at CDC while promoting better access to affordable healthcare coverage.

item.title: Ohio State Health & Discovery discusses cognitive behavioral therapy for weight loss
item.description: Ohio State Health & Discovery reports that cognitive behavioral therapy could help with weight loss by changing negative thought patterns around eating. Experts highlight how realistic goal-setting and positive reinforcement play key roles in this approach.
